outputs.summary: Desktop-only deleteEpic hard-deletes an epic. One transaction deletes every row that belongs to it (attempts, retry_grants, checkpoints, sprint_reports, approvals, sync_state, outbox, search_index, events, cached idempotency replies, runs, comments, ticket_status, drafts, plan_revisions, epic), then removes .darkmechanicus/epics/<id>/ and each run's history/<runId>/ folder. Refused with active_run_exists while a run is active. New human-only capability epic.delete; not an MCP tool. Deviations from the ticket text: the command lives in a new src/core/commands/deletion.ts instead of authoring.ts; files are removed inside the transaction (not after commit) so a removal failure rolls the rows back and the write lock keeps a concurrent reconcile from re-importing; removal checks every path for links/containment/plain entry names before deleting anything. Logs an epic.deleted event that names no deleted id. Not committed: commits were blocked by the session's auto-mode permission check.

outputs.summary: Desktop-only deleteTicket removes a ticket, its dependency edges and relations from the saved plan and saves a new revision in one step. It reuses the existing path inside one transaction (openDraft, updatePlanDraft with remove_ticket, requestSave), so a refusal at any step changes nothing and the full save validation applies. Refused while the draft has unsaved changes (conflict), a save is pending (save_pending), the epic is completed (completed_epic), or the ticket has a claimed/running/submitted attempt (conflict); unknown ticket or never-saved epic is not_found. An unchanged Edit draft does not block and is settled by the save. Logs ticket.deleted. The command flushes like savePlan and returns SaveResultView. New human-only capability ticket.delete; not an MCP tool. Deviation: service is a new src/core/services/ticketDeletion.ts and the command lives in src/core/commands/deletion.ts. Not committed (commit blocked by permission check).
